query:
WITH e AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT event_id,details,encode(sha256(convert_to(details::text,'UTF8')),'hex') event_sha FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_event WHERE event_id IN(85883,85884,85885)),
x AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT e.event_id,e.event_sha,e.details->>'settlement_date' settlement,x->'value' v,x->>'row_sha256' row_sha FROM e,jsonb_array_elements(details->'rows') x),
a AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.working_accepted_companies_v1),
r AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.massive_shortinterest_record_v1 WHERE archive_key='massive-archive:S02:c1ed3ed6aa5bad110f122c2459ba27f6daa14a7ac484363d4915c0fc9ddb1f88' AND raw_record->>'settlement_date' IN('2026-08-31','2026-09-15','2026-09-30')),
p AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.d02_anchor_source_point_v2 WHERE session_date IN('2026-08-31','2026-09-15','2026-09-30')),
ir AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.ref01_date_record_v4 WHERE point_date IN('2026-08-31','2026-09-15','2026-09-30')),
o AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT unit_key,source_published_at,historical_received_at,available_at,values_json FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_observation WHERE family_id='S02' AND release_id='top3000_companies_202608_202609_v1' AND effective_date IN('2026-08-31','2026-09-15','2026-09-30')),
cal AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT c FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_partition,jsonb_array_elements(denominator_evidence->'report_calendar') c WHERE family_id='S02' AND partition_key='short-interest-settlement-20260715-20260930'),
j AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT x.*,a.company_id,a.anchor_ticker,a.cohort_sha256,a.membership_acceptance_sha256,a.membership_accepted,r.unit_key,r.raw_record,r.raw_record_sha256,r.source_id,r.source_row,r.page_number,p.point_source_state,p.identity_source_sha256,p.identity_record_sha256,p.identity_source_ordinal,ir.record_sha256 ir_sha,ir.content ir_content,ir.company_id ir_company,ir.point_date ir_date,o.unit_key observation_unit,o.source_published_at,o.historical_received_at,o.available_at,o.values_json,cal.c
 FROM x LEFT JOIN a ON a.selection_order=(v->>'selection_order')::integer
 LEFT JOIN r ON r.raw_record->>'ticker'=a.anchor_ticker AND r.raw_record->>'settlement_date'=x.settlement
 LEFT JOIN p ON p.company_ordinal=a.selection_order AND p.session_date=x.settlement::date
 LEFT JOIN ir ON ir.point_date=p.session_date AND ir.ordinal=p.identity_source_ordinal AND ir.record_sha256=encode(p.identity_record_sha256,'hex') AND ir.content->>'source_sha256'=encode(p.identity_source_sha256,'hex')
 LEFT JOIN o ON o.unit_key=r.unit_key LEFT JOIN cal ON cal.c->>'settlement_date'=x.settlement)
SELECT event_id,settlement,min(event_sha) producer_sha,count(*) rows,count(DISTINCT v->>'selected_company_id') unique_companies,count(unit_key) source_matches,count(DISTINCT unit_key) unique_source_rows,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE v->>'identity_state'='DATED_ANCHOR_COMPANY_LINK_PRODUCER_CHECKED') dated_links,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE unit_key IS NULL) source_absent,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE unit_key IS NOT NULL AND v->>'identity_state'='DATED_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED') identity_held,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE row_sha IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(v::text,'UTF8')),'hex')) row_hash_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE company_id IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'selected_company_id' OR anchor_ticker IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'anchor_ticker' OR cohort_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'cohort_sha256' OR membership_acceptance_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'membership_acceptance_sha256' OR membership_accepted IS DISTINCT FROM true) membership_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE unit_key IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'source_unit_key' OR raw_record IS DISTINCT FROM nullif(v->'raw_record','null'::jsonb) OR raw_record_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'raw_record_sha256' OR (raw_record IS NOT NULL AND raw_record_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(raw_record::text,'UTF8')),'hex')) OR source_id IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'source_id' OR source_row IS DISTINCT FROM (v->>'source_row')::integer OR page_number IS DISTINCT FROM (v->>'source_page')::integer) source_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE v->>'identity_state' IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN unit_key IS NULL THEN 'SOURCE_ROW_ABSENT_REPORTABILITY_UNKNOWN' WHEN point_source_state='VERIFIED_POINT_AND_SOURCE_LINK' THEN 'DATED_ANCHOR_COMPANY_LINK_PRODUCER_CHECKED' ELSE 'DATED_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED' END OR v->>'identity_record_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(identity_record_sha256,'hex') OR v->>'identity_source_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(identity_source_sha256,'hex') OR (v->>'identity_source_ordinal')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM identity_source_ordinal) point_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE v->>'identity_state'='DATED_ANCHOR_COMPANY_LINK_PRODUCER_CHECKED' AND (ir_sha IS NULL OR ir_sha IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(ir_content::text,'UTF8')),'hex') OR ir_company IS DISTINCT FROM company_id OR ir_date IS DISTINCT FROM settlement::date OR ir_content#>>'{source_record,ticker}' IS DISTINCT FROM anchor_ticker)) identity_provenance_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE v->>'scheduled_publication_date' IS DISTINCT FROM c->>'scheduled_publication_date' OR (v->>'scheduled_publication_in_target_window')::boolean IS DISTINCT FROM ((c->>'scheduled_publication_date')::date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-09-30')) calendar_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE v->>'source_published_at' IS NOT NULL OR v->>'historical_received_at' IS NOT NULL OR v->>'available_at' IS NOT NULL OR source_published_at IS NOT NULL OR historical_received_at IS NOT NULL OR available_at IS NOT NULL) false_clock_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE unit_key IS NOT NULL AND observation_unit IS NULL) missing_original_observation,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE v->'family_accepted' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR v->'full_instrument_coverage' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb OR v->'independent_linkage_review' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb) false_acceptance_errors,
encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(row_sha,E'\n' ORDER BY (v->>'selection_order')::integer),'UTF8')),'hex') review_digest
FROM j GROUP BY event_id,settlement ORDER BY event_id;
